description: Two letters with envelopes from Dorothy Kavanaugh Bailey [Dana Bailey's mother] to Olive J. Chabot, Oct. 15, 1961 and Feb. 12, 1961. Six letters from Dorothy K. Bailey to Maria Chabot, Jan. 3, 1960 – May 15, 1962. Four letters from Maria Chabot to Dorothy K. Bailey, Feb. 23, 1962 – May 18, 1962. Dorothy K. Bailey photographs: four photographs of Dorothy Bailey and two photographs of her daughter, Molly Bailey.
title: Dorothy Kavanaugh Bailey
